character_profiles.distinctive_facial_traits_en: Petite oval V-line face with a small pointed chin and smooth contours; large expressive almond eyes with clear double eyelids, soft aegyo-sal, and dark pupils; delicate straight nose bridge with a refined narrow tip; small plump M-shaped cupid's-bow lips in soft coral-pink; straight chin-length burgundy-brown bob haircut with sparse wispy see-through bangs revealing straight dark-brown eyebrows and small silver hoop earrings.

Soft oval heart-shaped face with full smooth cheeks and a gently rounded V-chin; large bright round doe eyes with wide parallel double eyelids, prominent plump aegyo-sal, and soft brown eyeliner; straight nose bridge with a softly rounded tip; full glossy coral-rose lips with a defined cupid's bow; center-parted chestnut-brown long wavy hair framing the temples with wispy face-framing tendrils and gold square stud earrings.

Soft oval face with natural rounded cheeks and a gently tapered chin; round expressive eyes with natural double eyelids, subtle under-eye fullness, and straight dark eyebrows; smooth straight nose with a slightly rounded tip; natural rose-tinted lips with soft contours; dark black hair tied in a low ponytail with center-parted wispy curtain bangs sweeping across the forehead and temples.
